title: Claude Code: Push events into a running session with channels
summary: A channel is an MCP server that pushes events into a running local session (--channels), two-way like a chat bridge: Telegram, Discord and iMessage plugins, a fakechat demo and custom ones in research preview. Events arrive only while the session is open. Pro, Max and Ultra users without an organization can use them; Team and Enterprise need an Owner to enable them.
ideas: A channel could push 'a record changed' or 'a thread is waiting' into avenMAIA's running session.
Samuel could answer from the phone through a chat bridge while the session runs on the Mac.

took.idea: Push record and thread events into avenMAIA
